usage_requirements: No query:/passage: prefixes — input is raw (query, passage) text pairs via sentence_transformers CrossEncoder.predict() or transformers AutoModelForSequenceClassification

Default activation is Identity (config sbert_ce_default_activation_function = torch.nn.modules.linear.Identity): predict() returns raw logits roughly in [-10, 10], NOT probabilities; pass activation_fn=torch.nn.Sigmoid() to CrossEncoder if 0-1 scores are needed
Single-label sequence classification head (num_labels=1) — one relevance score per pair; no embeddings are produced (pooling not applicable)
Max sequence length 512 tokens (BERT max_position_embeddings); query+passage pairs longer than that must be truncated (tokenize with truncation=True)
Canonical repo id is now cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 (no dash before 6); the old id cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 resolves to it
known_issues: Repo renamed: the HF API resolves cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 to cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 — pin the new id to avoid tooling that fails on redirects
Community reports of low scores on fairly similar short texts outside the MS MARCO query-passage distribution (sentence-transformers issue #2874)
Original training hyperparameters are not documented, complicating faithful fine-tuning reproduction (sentence-transformers issue #3505)
Inputs beyond 512 tokens are silently truncated, dropping late-passage evidence; CPU throughput on long lists is a recurring complaint (sentence-transformers issue #2482)
Trained only on English MS MARCO passage ranking; scores are relative relevance logits, not calibrated probabilities, unless a sigmoid is applied
unknowns: embedding_dim (not applicable: cross-encoder emits a single relevance score, not embeddings; hidden_size is 384 but no embedding output exists)
independent (non-author) benchmark verification — all scores trace to the model card / SBERT docs maintained by the model authors
